_description: STOP zones for the daily-log template. Used by check-agent-ingest-preservation.py to verify compression preserves the schema vocabulary, section structure, status enum, YAML manifest keys, and anchor-incident example that downstream agents and orchestrators copy and fill in.
_verbatim_required_rationale: Section names + manifest-schema keys + status enum values that downstream orch and workers pattern-match on. The status enum (PLANNED/CLAIMED/IN_PROGRESS/DONE/FAILED/BLOCKED) is referenced by the validator script; manifest keys are the YAML schema; section names are how the orch navigates the file. The role-archetype slot is tracked as a verbatim string rather than a regex to avoid false positives on the bare word `code`.
_custom_id_patterns_rationale: H14 (artifact-existence) and sibling falsifier IDs are cross-references to SKILL.md falsifier definitions. Load-band vocabulary (light/steady/heavy/overloaded) drives the end-of-day verdict.
placeholder_required: <one sentence: where we are at hand-off time>
_placeholder_required_rationale: Bracketed substitution slots the orch must fill in when starting a new daily log or appending to an existing one. Count must not decrease.
_anchor_phrases_rationale: The annotated worked example anchors to a concrete buds 2026-05-19 licensing batch (A-fdroid-research + B-license-edit, FSL-1.1-MIT + Iron Law Addendum + F-Droid context). Path references to sibling templates, session-logs directory, meta-logs directory, and SKILL.md are how the orch navigates the skill family.
